A company laptop, mobile phone, and company car (depending on the role and experience level). An annual performance or year-end bonus. 8% holiday allowance. 30 vacation days per year (based on full-time employment), with the option to purchase additional leave. Employment conditions in line with the Dutch Metal & Engineering collective labour agreement (CAO Metaal & Techniek). The opportunity to work on innovative and sustainable energy projects that make a real impact on the energy transition. Key Responsibilities Design and develop electrical systems and energy solutions. Create detailed electrical drawings, schematics, and technical documentation. Translate customer requirements into practical, future-proof engineering solutions. Prepare functional descriptions, operation manuals, and technical documentation. Provide technical support to projectmanagement throughout the project lifecycle. Develop and configure PLC software, including programming controllers and integrating communication protocols such as Modbus TCP within Energy Management Systems (EMS). Ensure all designs comply with applicable regulations and industry standards, including NEN 3140 and IEC 62040. About You You are an analytical and solution-oriented Electrical Engineer who enjoys developing innovative energy solutions. You have strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and thrive in multidisciplinary project environments. You also bring: An MBO or Bachelor's degree (or equivalent working and thinking level) in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline. At least five years of relevant experience in electrical engineering. Experience creating electrical schematics and technical documentation. Experience with energy storage systems, renewable energy solutions, or similar applications is considered an advantage. Knowledge of communication protocols such as Modbus TCP and experience with Energy Management Systems (EMS) and/or SCADA systems. Experience with engineering software such as EPLAN, AutoCAD, or SEE Electrical. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Dutch is considered an advantage. Hier kom je te werken Our client is a leading engineering company specializing in reliable and sustainable energy solutions. They design, build, and maintain advanced power systems for critical infrastructure, including data centers, industrial facilities, commercial buildings, and energy storage applications. By combining innovative technologies with engineering expertise, they deliver intelligent energy solutions that support the transition to a more sustainable future.

The wide variety of our Food and Beverage concepts gives you the opportunity to broaden your horizon as you contribute to daily operations, team coordination, and commercial performance, ensuring smooth service delivery and memorable guest experiences.This internship starts in September 2026 and offers a full-time learning experience for a minimum of 5 months, aligned with your study requirements.Responsibilities• Support the Food and Beverage Manager in daily operations across all outlets• Lead by example on the floor, ensuring excellent service and guest satisfaction• Assist in coordinating restaurant, bar, breakfast, and event operations• Drive commercial performance by supporting upselling, promotions, and events• Monitor service quality and ensure brand standards are consistently maintained• Support team communication, shift organisation, and operational planning• Assist with training and coaching team members• Engage with guests, ensuring personalised and memorable experiences• Take ownership of assigned projects to improve performance and guest satisfactionEssential Requirements• Currently enrolled in a hospitality, hotel management, or related study programme• Strong communication skills in English, written and spoken• Passion for food, drinks, and guest service• Proactive, organised, and eager to learn in a dynamic environment• Availability for an internship of at least 5 months• Eligible to complete an internship in the NetherlandsPreferred Requirem

- Horst - 32 - 40 uur - € 3.000,- / € 3.300,- per maand Are you an experienced MIG/MAG welder looking for a job with good conditions and a pleasant working atmosphere? Then we have the job for you in Horst. What do we offer? - Salary between €3,000 and €3,300 gross per month; - 25 holidays and 13 ADV days; - Working hours between 07:00 and 16:30; - A full-time job of 40 hours or 32 - A pleasant team in which you will quickly feel at home; - Room to develop yourself further and to think along with others. What will you do? As a MIG/MAG welder, you are responsible for welding products based on technical drawings. You work accurately and contribute to a safe and efficient working environment. No two days are the same. - Welding of products according to the MIG/MAG welding process; - Working from technical drawings; - Carrying out visual inspections and marking the weld with chalk; - Checking welded materials for quality; - Removing spatter and burr residues; - Ensuring the proper functioning of the welding equipment; - Identifying deviations and contributing ideas for improvements; - Working in accordance with the applicable environmental and safety regulations. What do you bring? - Experience as a welder in a production environment; - MIG/MAG level 2 or similar; - Able to read technical drawings; - Independent, but also good at working together; - Flexible attitude and no 9-to-5 mentality; - Command of the Dutch or English language. You will connect financial results with the decisions made across the business. Your insights will help improve efficiency, profitability and working capital. The role is based in the Netherlands and involves regular travel across EMEA.
